decision: No quality-preserving architecture change qualified. Approximate four-FFN changes reduce fixed-input complete cycle latency about3%, with prediction/likelihood regressions.

draft-middle-confirm.method: two repeated fresh-process ABBA blocks, four heldout prompt domains,192 output tokens each

quality.scope: Same-prefix sensitivity to original quantized target, two held-out source-text prefixes,129 positions each; not broad task quality certification.

fixed_prefix.method: fresh-process ABBA per candidate; identical 2048-token held-out prefix and128 teacher-forced continuation tokens;16 complete Runtime::decode calls with all8 rows retained, first2 excluded; CPU logit scoring and file output outside timer
fixed_prefix.scope: compute/traffic cost for this fixed input; not a natural-generation throughput or quality equivalence claim

surrogate_fit.method: delta = Y_final_BF16 - residual_BF16; fit RMS-normalized BF16 X to delta with ridge regression and output PCA; three leave-one-calibration-prefix-out folds select rank and ridge; heldout source never used
surrogate_fit.tensor_format: F32 A [64,5120], B [5120,64]; unused rank coordinates padded zero; runtime latent/output BF16 then residual add
